title: Ceadir-Basket clinch 2024/25 title!
description: Ceadir-Basket clinched 2024/25 title in Moldova. They swept the Final series against Soroca 3-0. Ceadir-Basket closed the campaign with a final 95-75 win. They started with a 27-14 run and dominated the whole game. Denis Savca (190-G/F-1999) led the way with 22 points and Nicolae Grubii (178-PG-2000) nailed 11.
